nodes.title: Storyboard 布局参考图（上传9宫格线稿模板）

widgets_values:
REFERENCE IMAGE USAGE:
- Use the uploaded reference image ONLY as a structural storyboard-layout reference.
- Follow its exact 3x3 grid structure, equal panel proportions, thin borders, and rough grayscale pencil-storyboard presentation.
- Do NOT copy the specific car design, architecture, objects, lighting, textures, or material details from the reference image.
- The reference image controls layout and sketch presentation only; the scene content must follow the text instructions below.
- Preserve exactly 9 panels. Do not infer or add extra panels from any internal details in the reference image.

Create exactly ONE storyboard sheet as a single image.

STRICT LAYOUT RULES:
- exactly 9 panels total
- exactly 3 columns by 3 rows
- one clean 3x3 grid only
- all 9 panels must be equal size
- each panel must be clearly separated by thin borders
- do not create extra panels
- do not create 12 panels, 15 panels, or more
- do not use split panels
- do not use inset frames
- do not use collage layout
- do not use comic-book page layout

TEXT RULES:
- only small panel numbers 1 to 9
- place each number in the top-left corner of its panel
- no titles
- no captions
- no subtitles
- no speech bubbles
- no Chinese text
- no English text except the numbers 1–9
- no watermark
- no logo
- no QR code
- no random symbols

STYLE RULES:
- rough storyboard sketch
- black-and-white or grayscale only
- hand-drawn pencil sketch look
- clean line art with light gray shading
- simple tonal blocking only
- no photorealism
- no polished concept art rendering
- no glossy material rendering
- no realistic paint finish
- no highly detailed textures
- no cinematic color grading
- no rich surface materials
- no reflective metal rendering
- no final-production illustration look

The whole image must look like an early pre-production storyboard sketch sheet, not a finished illustration.

CONSISTENCY RULES:
- all 9 panels must depict the same silver Xiaomi SU7 with consistent overall shape and recognizable design
- all 9 panels must depict the same ancient Chinese autumn town environment
- maintain the same setting, same season, same time of day, and same vehicle identity across all panels
- the car must move forward consistently from left to right across the sequence
- every panel must show a different moment
- do not repeat the same composition
- do not repeat the same camera angle
- do not repeat the same pose or car position
- do not mirror or duplicate panels
- each panel must advance the story chronologically

SHOT PROGRESSION:
1. wide establishing shot of an ancient Chinese town street in autumn, fallen red and golden leaves on the ground
2. the silver Xiaomi SU7 enters the frame, medium-wide shot
3. front three-quarter shot of the car moving forward to the right
4. side tracking shot, leaves blowing past the car
5. low-angle dynamic shot emphasizing the wheel and body silhouette
6. the car passes traditional Chinese buildings, lanterns, and autumn details
7. closer rear three-quarter or side-window transitional shot, still moving forward to the right
8. close-up detail shot of the car body and window line, simplified as sketch only
9. wide final shot of the car continuing forward into the scenic ancient street

VISUAL PRIORITY:
- clear storytelling
- strong shot variety
- readable staging
- storyboard clarity over beauty
- sketch simplicity over material realism

The final result must be a professional 9-panel storyboard sketch sheet for video pre-visualization.
